class.name: CSGTopologySettings
class.brief_description: Configures optional topology-derived geometry for a [CSGShape3D].
class.description: Configures native topology processing performed after a [CSGShape3D] combines its local geometry and child Boolean operations, and before its result modifiers run. The temporary topology and adjacency data is only built when [member mode] is not [constant TOPOLOGY_NONE].

members.member: The minimum angle between adjacent triangle faces for their shared edge to be retained. Coplanar triangulation edges are always ignored.
The width of each closed edge volume, in meters.
The maximum distance between triangle vertices for them to be treated as the same geometric vertex while building adjacency.
The topology processing mode. No topology structures are built when this is [constant TOPOLOGY_NONE].

constants.constant: Replaces the shape with the union of closed volumes generated around its geometric edges.
